item.title: Synology-SA-99:01 Photo Station
item.description:
A vulnerability allows remote authenticated users to inject arbitrary web script via a susceptible version of Synology Photo Station.
CVE-2099-81001 is resolved in the current release.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:02 Example Library
item.description: None of Synology's products are affected by CVE-2099-81007, including DSM, because the affected library build is not shipped.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:03 DSM
item.description: CVE-2099-81002, CVE-2099-81003, CVE-2099-81004, CVE-2099-81006, CVE-2099-81008, CVE-2099-81009, CVE-2099-81010 and CVE-2099-81012 allow remote attackers to conduct denial-of-service attacks via a susceptible version of DiskStation Manager (DSM).
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:04 DSM, PHP
item.description:
Multiple vulnerabilities allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via susceptible versions of the following packages in DSM:
Glacier Backup Hyper Backup Mail Station PHP 8.2
CVE-2099-81017 is among them.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:05 Synology Assistant
item.description: Synology has released a security update for the Synology Assistant to address a vulnerability. CVE-2099-81005 allows local users to gain privileges via a susceptible version of Windows.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:06 SRM
item.description: The reported issue cannot be exploited via a susceptible version of DiskStation Manager (DSM) in its default configuration. CVE-2099-81016 is tracked for reference.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: DSM 9.9-99999
item.description: Description DSM 9.9-99999 addresses the vulnerabilities below and repairs systems affected by CVE-2099-81018.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:08 Example Package Server
item.description: A vulnerability allows remote attackers to read arbitrary files via a susceptible version of Example Package Server. CVE-2099-81015 was reported privately.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:09 Surveillance Station
item.description: Synology has released a security update for the Surveillance Station to address multiple vulnerabilities.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:10 BeeStation OS
item.description: A vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass access controls via a susceptible version of BeeStation OS. CVE-2099-81013 is fixed.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:11 DSM
item.description: A vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a susceptible version of DSM. CVE-2099-81011 is exploited in the wild.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)

item.title: Synology-SA-99:12 SRM
item.description: A vulnerability allows man-in-the-middle attackers to obtain sensitive information via a susceptible version of Synology Router Manager (SRM). CVE-2099-81014 is resolved.
item.author: security@synology.com (Synology Security Team)
